snippet.title: White Christmas - Official Demo Release Trailer (Version 2)
snippet.description:
"White Christmas" is a cozy multiplayer winter playground set in a snowy village. Build snowmen, trade gifts, rent skates, throw snowballs, and warm up at the Christmas market. Host a village with friends and turn a school-free snow day into shared holiday chaos.

Wishlist "White Christmas" on steam and play the demo:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5127300/White_Christmas/
